title: ITEM 13. Has Your FAA Airman Medical Certificate Ever Been Denied, Suspended, or Revoked?

blocks.text: The applicant shall check "yes" or "no." If "yes" is checked, the applicant should enter the date of action and should report details in the EXPLANATIONS box of Item 18.

blocks.text: The AME may not issue a medical certificate to an applicant who has checked "yes." The only exceptions to this prohibition are:
blocks.html: The AME may not issue a medical certificate to an applicant who has checked "yes." The only exceptions to this prohibition are:

blocks.text: - The applicant presents written evidence from the FAA that he or she was subsequently medically certificated and that an AME is authorized to issue a renewal medical certificate to the person if medically qualified; or
